coordinate_frames.task_space: not provided; no task-space action may be inferred

data_format: LeRobot v3.0 Parquet plus AV1 MP4 with ArmnetBench outcome extensions
known_limitations: Eight fixed benchmark task setups from one arm-farm source do not establish broad environment generalization.
Teleoperated reference demonstrations are always labelled successful; learned-policy rollouts carry human outcome labels.
The binary success field maps both failure and suboptimal to zero; consumers must retain success_class for three-way outcome learning.
Outcome classes are imbalanced: 915 successful, 1532 failure and 52 suboptimal episodes.
Published meta/stats.json contains stale per-field counts and episode ranges; qualification recomputes integrity from the episode index and all trajectory tables.
The source publishes only a train split; project splits must be frozen independently.
Packed video files contain unreferenced time gaps where episodes were dropped before publication; explicit per-episode from/to timestamps are authoritative.
Camera intrinsics/extrinsics and a common task-space action frame are not published.
native_action_semantics: Absolute calibrated SO-101 position command: five revolute joints in degrees and gripper in normalized 0..100 range.
redistribution_terms: Preserve the Apache-2.0 license and notices, state material changes, and do not use contributor names or marks to imply endorsement.
